title: Hybrid state-space and attention neural operators for nonlinear structural dynamics under environmental loading
abstract: arXiv:2611.29334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The computational burden of repeated nonlinear time-history analyses limits their application for structural assessment and design. We therefore propose DeepOJamba, a hybrid neural operator that combines selective state-space recurrence with full attention to predict the structural response history due to dynamic loading. Physical-parameter conditioning and predicted-state transfer between sequences enable a single trained operator to represent varying system conditions and generate response histories beyond its training sequence length. DeepOJamba is evaluated on a 15~MW monopile offshore wind turbine under wind and wave loading. translated_title: 面向环境荷载作用下非线性结构动力学的混合状态空间-注意力神经算子
translated_abstract: 重复非线性时程分析的巨大计算负担限制了其在结构评估与设计中的应用。因此，我们提出了DeepOJamba，一种将选择性状态空间递归与全局注意力机制相结合的混合神经算子，用于预测动态荷载作用下的结构响应时程。通过物理参数条件化以及序列间的预测状态传递，单个训练好的算子即可表征不同的系统条件，并生成超出其训练序列长度的响应时程。DeepOJamba在15 MW单桩式海上风力机上于风浪荷载作用下进行了评估。将该算子与纯注意力、纯状态空间、傅里叶以及DeepONet算子进行了比较，结果显示其在每个通道上均取得最低的窗口误差，并取得最低的闭环疲劳与极限荷载误差，分别为9.4%和6.0%，而次优的纯注意力算子误差为14.6%和8.7%。
tldr: 提出结合选择性状态空间递归与全局注意力的混合神经算子DeepOJamba，可在海上风电结构的动态荷载响应预测中以最低误差（疲劳9.4%、极限荷载6.0%）超越各类主流神经算子，并支持参数变化与更长序列的外推预测。
en_tdlr: DeepOJamba, a hybrid neural operator combining selective state-space recurrence with full attention, achieves the lowest errors in predicting nonlinear structural responses to environmental loading on an offshore wind turbine, with closed-loop fatigue and ultimate-load errors of 9.4% and 6.0%, outperforming pure attention, state-space, Fourier, and DeepONet operators.
